ideas.title: Minnesota Medical Transport Company Fraud Investigation
ideas.description: Investigate the Minnesota medical transport company accused of fraud, leading to contract termination and 95 workers being jobless.
ideas.angle: Follow the money trail to uncover potential misuse of funds and connections to other entities.
questions: What were the specific allegations against the company?
How did the company respond to the allegations?
ideas.insight: This story has potential for uncovering a larger scheme involving healthcare and transportation services in Minnesota.
